SUN_S1E05_P01.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E05_P01.text: For me to have already made a mess of.

SUN_S1E05_P01.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E05_P01.text: I told a cousin Elias Bell might come home.

SUN_S1E05_P01.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E05_P01.text: A son who left years ago. His mother's wake has already started.

SUN_S1E05_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P01.text: They are waiting for a man because Samuel put my face on him. I'd rather disappoint them once than let them keep waiting.

SUN_S1E05_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P02.text: No, ma'am. I'm sorry. My name is Kael Mack.

SUN_S1E05_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E05_P02.text: He does like to cover himself.

SUN_S1E05_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P02.text: Then I understand why this is hard.

SUN_S1E05_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P02.text: No, sir. None of this has been convenient.

SUN_S1E05_P03.speaker: Owen Bell
SUN_S1E05_P03.text: You were there when she promised it. Say what she said.

SUN_S1E05_P03.speaker: Owen Bell
SUN_S1E05_P03.text: You keep saying that like it settles anything.

SUN_S1E05_P03.speaker: Mara Bell
SUN_S1E05_P03.text: If you would just tell him she meant it—

SUN_S1E05_P03.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P03.text: I can't be your witness because I believe you.

SUN_S1E05_P03.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P03.text: I can help them. I can't become Elias long enough to win an argument.

SUN_S1E05_P03.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P03.text: Very little in this particular dispute.

SUN_S1E05_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P04.text: You were about to ask me to be Elias for five minutes.

SUN_S1E05_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E05_P04.text: Fine. Yes. You say you heard the promise, they stop fighting, we leave.

SUN_S1E05_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P04.text: And next year somebody asks what else Elias said.

SUN_S1E05_P04.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E05_P04.text: Maybe somebody does. We get to leave either way.

SUN_S1E05_P04.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E05_P04.text: Please don't make me regret defending you.

SUN_S1E05_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E05_P04.text: Defend him and then pretend you're defending a principle.

SUN_S1E05_P04.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E05_P04.text: Maybe he keeps picking useful principles.

SUN_S1E05_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P04.text: I can leave if this conversation would improve without me.

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Mara Bell
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: You told me Elias would remember 'the blue room stays open.'

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: I told you Elias might come home. I never heard that phrase.

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: Mara, did you explain it to him?

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Mara Bell
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: I didn't explain anything to him.

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: So either Mara remembers it wrong, Samuel is lying, or—

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: Or someone else touched the story.

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Mara Bell
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: Touched it? It is my family.

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: You're right. Bad choice of words.

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: Could the investigation wait until the tables are under cover?

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: How are you carrying chairs right now?

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: I'm bothered. I'm also getting rained on.

SUN_S1E05_P05.speaker: Mara Bell
SUN_S1E05_P05.text: You can start with the heavy ones.

SUN_S1E05_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E05_P06.text: It would have been easier if you'd lied.

SUN_S1E05_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E05_P06.text: Tomorrow they remember Elias came home and said it. I'd be gone, but the lie wouldn't.

SUN_S1E05_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E05_P06.text: You think about things after you leave.

SUN_S1E05_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E05_P06.text: You pretend not to be bothered.

SUN_S1E05_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E05_P06.text: You also proved my point better than I did.
